_extraction.method: Proof extraction, hand-verified against the detail pages.
_extraction.discipline: severity/hard_stop derived from the stated action text, never invented. 'Stop driving!' => stop_now+hard_stop; 'emergency mode possible' => caution, hard_stop=false. color assigned from Skoda danger-tier convention + verbatim DANGER/WARNING headers (confidence encodes strength). source_page = PDF index (printed page + 2).
_extraction.scope_note: vehicle_scope 'skoda_gas' = the make-by-powertrain platform sheet; applies to Kamiq/Scala/Octavia(gas)/Fabia/Karoq per the shared-inventory finding.
_extraction.coverage_note: 6 core safety-critical indicators as a proof slice; the full overview (pp.13-14) lists about 40, which are not extracted.

indicators.meaning_en: Brake fluid level is too low. Problems/faults with the brake system can extend braking distance; danger of brake failure.
indicators.message_text: Stop driving! Seek the help of a specialist garage.

indicators.name_en: Brake system and anti-lock braking system faulty
indicators.meaning_en: Red brake symbol illuminates together with the ABS symbol - combined brake/ABS fault.
indicators.message_text: Stop driving! Seek the help of a specialist garage.

indicators.meaning_en: Coolant level too low (risk of engine/cooling-system damage). If it cannot be topped up sufficiently, or coolant is being lost, stop.
indicators.message_text: If it is not possible to top up with sufficient coolant: Stop driving. Stop the engine and seek the help of a specialist garage.

indicators.meaning_en: Petrol engine control fault. Driving in emergency (limp) mode is possible; a noticeable reduction in engine performance may occur.

indicators.name_en: Front Assist - safety distance too small / collision warning
indicators.meaning_en: Front Assist warns that the distance to the vehicle ahead is too small or a collision risk exists; may brake to help avoid a collision.
Flashing indicates ESC is actively engaged (stabilising the vehicle). This is a status indication, not a fault.
